name: Hansi Flick
scopeNote: Narrowed on 2026-11-04: only Bayern Munich 2019-21 and Barcelona 2024- are counted; the Germany spell (2021-23, one tactical piece and attributed quotes) is excluded and its sources stay in the file as context with verified false. Counted spells proposed by the researcher at the user's request: Bayern Munich 2019-21 (treble/sextuple; high line, gegenpressing), Germany 2021-23 (same high-line pressing model, but poor results and first-ever sacking) and Barcelona from 1 July 2024 (domestic trebles, offside trap, high line; FC Barcelona's staff page dated 2026-10-18 still lists him as coach, contract to 2028). The three spells share one recognisable style (very high line, early pressing, vertical transitions, trust in youth), so the profile is the signature style, not a career average. Excluded: assistant jobs, Hoffenheim, Salzburg and DFB sporting director roles (no head-coach evidence). Bayern start: Kovac was dismissed 3 Nov 2019 (sources say 'November 2019'), first match 6 Nov v Olympiacos in the Champions League (first Bundesliga match 9 Nov v Dortmund; corrected on 2026-11-04 from the bayern-2019-20 team research) vs Dortmund; exact day from memory, flagged. Bayern end 30 Jun 2021 and Germany start 1 Aug 2021 are not in the mined pages (FC Barcelona profile says only 'a job he retained until September 2023'). Popular label 'tiki-taka/possession Barca' is wrong for his team: sources describe verticality, offside trap and quick transitions. Partial dates in spellsExcluded (years/months only) are approximate and not needed for the profile.
openQuestions: Bayern start (3 Nov 2019) and end (30 Jun 2021), Germany start (1 Aug 2021) and Barcelona start (1 Jul 2024) are not confirmed by a mined page; Barcelona was announced 29 May 2024.

Barcelona 2025/26 and 2026/27 tactical coverage mined is thin (Henry criticism, contract extension); a report of players questioning the high line after the Atletico cup semi-final (El Gol Digital) was not mined.
Germany spell: mostly attributed Sport Bild quotes; match-level tactical analysis of Germany not mined beyond BFW.
Man-management evidence is mostly tier C/attributed; Boateng/Alaba departure frictions not examined.

sources.title: StatsBomb - Bayern's pressing under Flick
sources.evidence: Bayern's pressing, which is far less hesitant than under the previous manager, pressing on the first build-up line and consistently pushing up.

sources.title: StatsBomb - Bayern's pressing under Flick

sources.title: StatsBomb - Bayern's pressing under Flick

sources.title: StatsBomb - Bayern's pressing under Flick

sources.title: StatsBomb - Bayern's pressing under Flick

sources.title: Bavarian Football Works - Film Room: Bayern's high line and team pressing

sources.title: Bavarian Football Works - Film Room: Bayern's high line and team pressing

sources.title: Bavarian Football Works - Film Room: Bayern's high line and team pressing

However, this tactic is risky if opposition players stay onside.

sources.title: Bavarian Football Works - Film Room: Bayern's high line and team pressing

sources.title: Bavarian Football Works - Film Room: Bayern's high line and team pressing
